'''December 2000 Vancouver tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Vancouver, BC on 3 December 2000. [[Kevin Wan]] won it. It is known from Kevin Wan's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1510">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-04-vancouver-b-c-dec-3-2000d1510/ vancouver-b-c-dec-3-2000], DeckTech (Kevin "Frog" Wan, 4 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-04-vancouver-b-c-dec-3-2000d1510/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Vancouver, BC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Kevin Wan]]
